name: tree
title: Tree
description: UI SDK Tree styled as indented rows with guide lines: a file explorer from paths with folder and file icons, checkable trees with mixed branches, lazy branches, links and a flat list for virtualizing.
docs: `<Tree aria-label paths>` (or `items`) renders every row for you: an indicator, `checkable` checkboxes, an icon from `icon` (`treeFileIcon` by default: open or closed folders, file icons by extension; a function of the item and its state, or `false`) and the label. Compose `TreeItem` > `TreeItemLabel` (+ `TreeItemIndicator`, `TreeItemCheckbox`) and `TreeGroup` yourself, or `TreeNodes items icon checkable`, to render your own rows while the tree keeps the whole hierarchy. Rows indent by `--tree-level` and each open group draws a guide through its parent's indicator. Selection (`mode`, `value`, `activation`), expansion (`expanded`), checks (`checked`, `checkStrategy`) and `onAction` are UI SDK's; `toggleTreeItem(items, checked, value, strategy)` computes a checked value you keep yourself. Items with `href` render as links that follow on press (`onFollow` for a client router). For thousands of rows, keep `items` on the tree and render only the rows in view from `visibleTreeRows(items, expanded)`, scrolling in `onHighlight`; every item sets `--tree-level`, so flat rows indent the same.
